states: only matching rows; per-row reason (your review requested / required Evidence missing / changes requested), expected actor and owner; lifecycle (incl. draft) and verification stay separate; search over title, owner, service, repo, PR; no-match/unauthorized/WYRD_CHANGE_502 keep the filter

g.text: One scrolling form — never a wizard. Save an incomplete draft at any point.
Raise checkout ranking cutoff for high-risk carts

held carts rise ~0.6% → ~2.2% · capture errors fall — editable, shown to every reviewer
one or more · exact base → candidate commits are the identity

no branch is ever an identity
